title: KV memory-map onboarding and sequence-affinity profile playbook
creator: Marco Chen
description:
Problem: New open models with extended context windows frequently show unstable latency and token-cost characteristics when routed to the default KV cache implementation. We need a deterministic onboarding playbook that generates a KV memory-map profile per model + per sequence-length distribution (sequence-affinity), pins recommended memory-map variants to a model version, and publishes these artifacts to the profile registry so the serving runtime can route and select kernels automatically.

Goals: 1) Produce a reproducible profiling pipeline that captures: cold/warm KV memory footprint, per-step latency (quantiles), burst behavior, and cache retention effectiveness across typical sequence-length buckets. 2) Define a pinning policy that maps model versions -> memory-map variant (and fallbacks) with clear stability windows. 3) Implement a publishing workflow (artifact format, schema, signing) so Console and the orchestrator can consume profiles for rollout and automatic rollback. 4) Provide a lightweight validation harness that can be run in Dedicated/Private preflight to ensure the pinned variant meets latency/cost SLOs.

Scope: - Profiling harness and sequence-affinity sampler - Memory-map schema v1 (metadata + per-bucket statistics + artifact checksum) - Pinning rules engine prototype (priority, TTL, canary percent) - Publishing CLI that uploads to profile-registry and triggers Console index update - Validation harness and gating checks for rollout.

Non-goals: Full autoscaling integration (follow-up), model quantization changes (handled by optimize), or complex kernel selection logic (runtime will consume profile hints).

Acceptance criteria: - End-to-end run on three target models (one Llama-derivative, one Mistral-derivative, one community long-context model) produces consistent profile artifacts and an entry in the registry. - Pinning rule applied to model version results in expected fallback behavior in a sim environment (canary 5%, ramp to 50% then 100%). - Console shows per-model sequence-affinity histogram and pinned variant metadata. - Documentation + playbook committed to repo and linked in Console onboarding flow.

Risks and mitigation: - Profiling noise: mitigate by synthetic seeding and multi-run aggregation. - Artifact schema churn: include schema versioning and backward-compat checks. - Wrong pinning causing regressions: require validation harness pass and 24h canary window before full rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Profile artifacts generated for 3 target models and published to registry
Pinning rules applied in simulation show correct fallback behavior
Console displays sequence-affinity histograms and variant metadata
Validation harness passes before canary promotion
